yanks.definition: Form of yank (plural): A sudden, vigorous pull (sometimes defined as mass times jerk, or rate of change of force).

yapped.definition: Form of yap (participle past): Of a small dog, to bark.

yard.definition: A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

yardmaster.definition: A railway employee who is in charge of a railway yard.

yards.definition: Form of yard (plural): A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

yardstick.definition: A measuring rod thirty-six inches (one yard) long.

yarns.definition: Form of yarn (plural): A twisted strand of fibre used for knitting or weaving.

yawned.definition: Form of yawn (participle past): To open the mouth widely and take a long, rather deep breath, often because one is tired or bored, and sometimes accompanied by pandiculation.

yeah.definition: Form of year (colloquial pronunciation-spelling): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

year.definition: Form of here (pronunciation-spelling): This place; this location.

years.definition: Form of year (plural): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

yell.definition: To shout; holler; make a loud sound with the voice, especially to express intense emotions such as anger or excitement.

yelled.definition: Form of yell (participle past): To shout; holler; make a loud sound with the voice, especially to express intense emotions such as anger or excitement.

yelling.definition: Form of yell (gerund participle present): To shout; holler; make a loud sound with the voice, especially to express intense emotions such as anger or excitement.

yellowed.definition: Form of yellow (participle past): To become yellow or yellower.

yes.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.

yessir.definition: Term of address to a male; mate; buddy.

yesterday.definition: The day immediately before today; one day ago.

yesterdays.definition: Form of yesterday (plural): The day immediately before today; one day ago.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

yield.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yielded.definition: Form of yield (participle past): To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yielding.definition: Form of yield (gerund participle present): To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yoke.definition: Form of yolk (misspelling): The yellow, spherical part of an egg that is surrounded by the white albumen, and serves as nutriment for the growing young.

york.definition: To bowl a yorker at a batsman, especially to get a batsman out in this way.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: Offspring, especially the immature offspring of animals.

younger.definition: Form of young (comparative): In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youngsters.definition: Form of youngster (plural): A young person.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

youth’s.definition: The quality or state of being young.

zero.definition: The numeric symbol that represents the cardinal number zero.

zest.definition: The outer skin of a citrus fruit, used as a flavouring or garnish.

zigzag.definition: A line or path that proceeds by sharp turns in alternating directions.

zigzagging.definition: Form of zigzag (gerund participle present): To move or to twist in a zigzag manner.

zinc.definition: A chemical element (symbol Zn) with an atomic number of 30, a blue-silvery metal that is slightly brittle at room temperature and tarnishes slightly in moist air.

zodiac.definition: Form of zodiac: The belt-like region of the celestial sphere, approximately eight degrees north and south of the ecliptic, which includes the apparent path of the sun, moon, and visible planets.

zoologists.definition: Form of zoologist (plural): One who studies or practices zoology.
